cases.exit_words: terminated by Activision Blizzard or its affiliates (including Microsoft) without "cause" or the named executive officer resigned for "good reason"
cases.notes: Item 402(t) estimate in the Microsoft merger proxy (assumed closing 2022-03-08). The table shows $0 equity: Kotick held no unvested awards that would accelerate, so his already-owned shares are not in the parachute. The merger closed 2023-10-13 and Activision stopped filing; tenure_end is the closing date (when he left the board per the 8-K); Activision filed nothing on his later departure as CEO, so no SEC filing states the actual payout. Benefits are two years of health coverage plus supplemental life insurance through October 2026.

cases.exit_words: a termination of employment by Splunk and/or Parent without "cause" or by the executive officer for "good reason"
cases.notes: Item 402(t) estimate in the Cisco merger proxy (assumed closing 2023-10-15). Cash of $9,842,123 = $1,800,000 salary severance + $2,250,000 bonus severance + $792,123 prorated target bonus + $5,000,000 retention bonus. Equity assumes post-FY2023 PSUs at maximum; part of it vests at closing regardless of termination. The proxy refers to a 'Parent Employment Agreement' with Cisco, i.e. Steele was expected to stay on after the March 2024 closing. No in-tenure TSR table (Splunk filed no 10-K after FY2023, and its PvP TSR starts 2020-01-31).
